rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something reminds someone of a memory, person, or image.

example.english: This old song can evoke memories of our childhood.
example.traditional: 呢首老歌令人諗起我哋細個嗰段日子。
example.jyutping: ni1 sau2 lou5 go1 ling6 jan4 nam2 hei2 ngo5 dei6 sai3 go3 go2 dyun6 jat6 zi2

rows.note: Use this when something stirs up a memory or emotion, especially one that had faded or been suppressed.

example.english: The smell of coffee can evoke my longing for Grandma.
example.traditional: 咖啡香一飄過，就勾起我對阿嫲嘅思念。
example.jyutping: gaa3 fe1 hoeng1 jat1 piu1 gwo3 zau6 ngau1 hei2 ngo5 deoi3 aa3 maa4 ge3 si1 nim6

rows.note: Use this for making someone associate something with an idea, image, or other thing rather than specifically remembering it.

example.english: This painting can evoke an image of the sea before a storm.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫令人聯想到暴風雨前嘅海面。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ling6 jan4 lyun4 soeng2 dou3 bou6 fung1 jyu5 cin4 ge3 hoi2 min6
